title: Alweda Alweda ya Hussain Alweda
body:
ALVIDA ALVIDA YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
AY SUKOON–E–FATIMA ALVIDA ALVIDA
YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
EK SAWALE–E–ABB PER ASGHAR KO JAB LEY AAYE SHAH
<<DIVIDER>>
HALQ–E–ASGHAR DAST–E–SHAEPER TEER SE CHEDA GAYA
AY ZIBEY BEY KHATA ALVIDA ALVUDA YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
SEENA–E–AKBAR PA JO ZALIM NEY MAARI HAI SINAH.
ZAIANB–O–LAILA KE ARMAAOUN PE HAI MARI SEENAH.
<<DIVIDER>>
AY SHABHIE–E–MUSTAFA ALVIDA ALVIDA YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
KARBALA KI RETH HAI JIS KA TAN ROUNDA GAYA .
QAIMAY MEIN HAI JISKAY TUKDOUN KO AABA MEIN LAAYE SHAH.
AYE HASSAN KE DIL RUBA ALVIDA ALVIDA YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
<<DIVIDER>>
MUHKE BAL JO GIRPADA PARCHAM KO NA JHUKNEY DIA.
AYE AQI–E–MUJTABA HOO AAP PAR JANE FIDA.
AYE ALAMDAR–E–WAFA ALVIDA ALVIDA YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
MAA SE JO WADA KIYA HAI WAQT–E–AQAR DOUNO NE .
<<DIVIDER>>
MAA KA SAR UNCHA KIYA HAI AUN–O–JAFFAR DOUNONE .
FAKHRAY BINTE MURTUZA ALVIDA ALVIDA YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA
ISTARHA BAAD–E–SHAHADATH SHAE KO TADPAYA GAYA .
AQROBA SAB BEY RIDA AUR NOK–E–NAIZA SAR CHADA .
<<DIVIDER>>
AYE SHAHEY KARBALA. ALVIDA ALVIDA YA HUSAAIN ALVIDA
HAI WAFADARNE GHAZI KI SADAYEIN ALVIDA .
KEHTAY HAIN RO RO KE AKHTHER AAJ SAB AHLAY AZA .
UMM–E–ZAINAB FATIMA ALVIDA ALVIDA YA HUSSAIN ALVIDA..
